member.name: F:Microsoft.NET.ProjectData.CacheFileReader.CurrentMajorVersion
member.summary: The wire-format version header is version=<major>[.<minor>]. The reader accepts any file whose MAJOR version matches the major it was built for, regardless of the minor: a newer minor only adds forward-compatible data (new sections, keys, or @metadata) that the parsing loop below ignores. A different major is rejected as a clean cache miss because the reader cannot safely interpret a format whose major it doesn't understand. Absence of a minor component (e.g. version=2) is treated as .0.

member.summary: Scans for NuGet/{hash}/{nativeSuffix} matches. When is non-null, only NuGet folders whose path contains {sep}obj{sep}{configurationName}{sep} are considered. member.name: T:Microsoft.NET.ProjectData.StringPool
member.summary:
A thread-safe string deduplication pool. Ensures that equal strings share a single object instance, reducing memory when many projects carry identical paths (SDK refs, analyzer paths, NuGet packages, capabilities, property keys, etc.).
Internally uses striped s so concurrent readers and writers experience minimal contention. Striping improves cache locality across the 16 independent buckets.
The pool is intended to live as long as the data it deduplicates (e.g. scoped to the DataModelSharedState lifetime). It is not self-evicting — entries stay until the pool is collected.

member.name: F:Microsoft.NET.ProjectData.CacheFormat.Sections.MetadataBySection
member.summary: Item @metadata keys the writer can emit, keyed by the WIRE section that carries them (resolved through the section's itemType link in the schema). Used by forward-compatibility preservation to judge "known" metadata per section, so a newer writer that reuses an existing metadata name on a different item type is still preserved rather than mistaken for regenerable data. Only sections whose item type emits metadata appear here; a section absent from the map emits no metadata.

member.name: T:Microsoft.NET.ProjectData.PathSentinels
member.summary: Sentinel prefixes embedded in encoded paths in the .lscache file. The writer rewrites version-specific or location-specific paths to these sentinels so the cache is portable across machines and SDK upgrades; the reader resolves them via CachePathResolver.

member.summary: Roslyn/CPS dependency-node TFM identifier.
